title: The Matrix
synopsis: Wake up, Neo. The white rabbit, the office, the call. Red pill, blue pill. Choose what kind of life you were going to have anyway.

nodes.text: A green prompt. Wake up, Neo. A knock at the door.

choices.consequence: “Open” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Brave.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Wise.

nodes.text: Two grand for the disk. Follow the white rabbit, he says.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Go with them.” The story records the instinct as “Path” and carries it forward.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Safe.

nodes.text: A woman in leather at a club. She tells you the question is what drives you.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Listen.” The story records the instinct as “Path” and carries it forward.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Wise.

nodes.text: Agents at your desk. Smith. Phone in a parcel.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Path—follows you into whatever comes next.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.

nodes.text: Morpheus says go to the ledge. You can't. They take you.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Try anyway.” The story records the instinct as “Brave” and carries it forward.
There is no taking “Cooperate” back. Smart shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: A bug crawls under your skin. Trinity removes it.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Path.
You commit to “Run.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Red or blue. Morpheus, sincere.

choices.consequence: “Red” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Path.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.

nodes.text: You are pulled out of a pod. You are weak. You are real.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Heal.
You commit to “Look around.” The story records the instinct as “Curious” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Hovercraft, crew, a captain. Real food is gruel.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Eat it” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
“Refuse” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Spoiled.

nodes.text: Jiu-jitsu uploaded. You wake fluent.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Brave.
“Spar carefully” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Smart.

nodes.text: Black emptiness. Morpheus shows you the system.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Listen carefully.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.
There is no taking “Argue” back. Spirit shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: A man named Tank brings you tea. He was born free.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Friend.
There is no taking “Stay alone” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Cookies. A small woman. She tells you what you needed to hear, not what you wanted.

choices.consequence: “Believe her” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Path.
“Doubt her” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: Cypher misses steak. He misses being unconscious. He betrays.

choices.consequence: “Spot it earlier” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wise.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honest—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Agents pursue. Morpheus, captured, is taken to a building.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Heart—follows you into whatever comes next.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Smart—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Marble. Guards. Sunglasses. Many rounds expended.

choices.consequence: “Run the lobby” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Brave.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Smart—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: A helicopter. Morpheus on a chair.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Pilot.” The story records the instinct as “Brave” and carries it forward.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Smart.

nodes.text: Smith on a platform. You face him.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Brave—follows you into whatever comes next.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Wise—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Smith corners you in a hallway. Bullets stop.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Path.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honest—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: You break Smith apart from the inside.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Final—follows you into whatever comes next.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honor—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Call ended. You step out of the booth. You can fly.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Path.
There is no taking “Walk a block first” back. Style shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You become a teacher and a target. You fly often. You also, occasionally, take the bus, because the bus passes a place that used to be your apartment.
You spend a decade rebuilding Zion's defenses. You marry Trinity. You retire, eventually, to teach kids how to fly. The kids, mostly, prefer running.
You broker, eventually, a peace between humans and machines. The truce holds for a generation. After that, you don't know. You are, for now, content with a generation.
